app.name: LaabhMitra
footer.disclaimer: Information only. Not affiliated with the Government of India. Final decisions are made by the implementing agency.
state.offline_help: Check that the backend is running on port 8000, then try again.
state.no_profile: Tell us about your business first.
state.no_profile_help: We need your state and the kind of business to check schemes.
welcome.title: Find the government schemes your business may be eligible for
welcome.lead: Answer a few questions in about 2 minutes. Rules from official sources decide what fits. We explain why, show what is missing, and help you prepare the application.
consent.title: Before we start
consent.use: We use your answers only to check which schemes fit your business.
consent.no_ids: We never ask for or store Aadhaar, PAN or bank account numbers, or passwords.
consent.optional: Questions about gender, caste category and family income are optional. You can choose "Prefer not to say".
consent.no_submit: We do not submit applications or log in to any portal for you.
consent.agree: I agree that LaabhMitra may save my answers to check scheme eligibility.
onboard.title: Tell us about your business
onboard.lead: Type or speak in your own words, or tap the answers. We ask the most useful question first.
onboard.need_basics: We need your state and kind of business first.
business.title: Your business
business.empty: Your answers will appear here as you give them.
business.privacy: We store only yes/no for documents such as PAN, never the numbers.
demo.title: Try a demo business
demo.lead: Loads a sample profile and shows its results.
demo.none: Demo profiles are not available right now.
chat.title: Profile chat
chat.hello: Namaste. Tell me about your business in one or two sentences. For example: "I am a tailor in Mandya village and want to start a small garment unit costing 8 lakh."
chat.placeholder: Type here, or tap an answer above
chat.mic_failed: Could not hear you. Please type instead.
chat.not_understood: I could not find business details in that. Please tap an answer or say it another way.
chat.extract_failed: I could not read that right now. Please tap an answer instead.
chat.done: That is all I need for now. Tap "See my schemes".
q.state: Which state is your business in?
q.business_activity: What kind of business is it?
q.area_type: Is it in a village or a town/city?
q.is_new_project: Are you starting a new unit?
q.trade: Do you work in one of these traditional trades?
q.owner_age: How old are you? Type your age.
q.loan_amount_needed_inr: How much loan do you need? Tap or type an amount.
q.project_cost_inr: What is the total cost of the project? Tap or type an amount.
q.udyam_registered: Is your business registered on Udyam?
q.pan_available: Do you have a PAN card?
q.annual_turnover_inr: About how much are your sales in a year?
q.investment_plant_machinery_inr: About how much have you spent on machines and equipment?
q.gst_registered: Is your business registered for GST?
q.has_vending_proof: Do you have a vending certificate, vendor ID or Letter of Recommendation?
q.family_annual_income_inr: About how much does your family earn in a year?
q.social_category: Which social category do you belong to?
q.prior_govt_subsidy: Has this unit already received a government subsidy?
q.govt_employee_in_family: Is anyone in your family a government employee?
q.previous_mudra_tarun_repaid: Have you fully repaid an earlier Mudra Tarun loan?
why.owner_gender: Optional. Some schemes are only for women, or give women a higher subsidy.
why.family_annual_income_inr: Optional. Udyogini has a family income limit.
why.social_category: Optional. Some schemes give SC, ST, OBC or minority applicants a higher subsidy. If you skip this we show a range.
opt.basket_mat_broom_coir_maker: Basket, mat, broom or coir maker
results.title: Schemes you may be eligible for
results.lead: Every result comes from written rules with a source. Amounts are estimated.
results.hint: {step}: this one step opens {count} more options.
results.empty.ready: No scheme is fully ready yet. Look under "Likely" and "One step away".
results.empty.likely: Nothing here. No scheme is waiting on more information.
results.empty.one_step: Nothing here. No scheme is one step away.
results.empty.not_now: Nothing here. No scheme has been ruled out.
results.empty.watchlist: No announced schemes match your business right now.
headline.subsidy_note: Estimated, from the best set of schemes that can be combined.
headline.subsidy_range: Estimated. At least {min}, depending on your category.
headline.no_subsidy_note: We do not show a subsidy unless the rules support it.
headline.credit_note: Largest single option: up to {amount}. These are alternatives, not a total.
headline.no_credit_note: No credit option matches right now.
headline.never_added: Subsidies and loans are shown separately and are never added together.
fraud.udyam_free: Udyam registration is free on the official portal. Beware of look-alike sites and agents that charge money.
map.title: Your opportunity map
map.lead: Four separate buckets. Money you keep is never mixed with money you repay.
map.grants_note: Not repaid. Some cannot be combined: see the best path.
map.credit_note: Loans and guarantees. You repay these.
map.fee_note: Costs the government covers for you.
map.non_monetary_note: No money, but it opens other schemes.
map.none: Nothing in this bucket right now.
map.how_intro: Amounts are worked out by fixed formulas from the scheme rules and your answers. No AI is used for amounts or eligibility.
map.label: Estimated maximum. Final amount is decided by the implementing agency.
detail.not_found: We could not find this scheme.
detail.hidden: This scheme is not shown in your list because another route fits you better or it does not apply.
detail.need_info: We need this information from you.
detail.rules_decide: Rules decide the result. The explanation only puts it in plain words.
path.title: Your best path
path.lead: Some schemes cannot be combined, and the order matters. These are the best sets of subsidies that fit together.
path.name: Path {letter}
path.tradeoff: Choosing this path closes the other
path.none_help: None of the subsidy schemes fit your business today. Your credit options are below.
path.credit_note: Listed separately. Loans are never added to subsidies.
path.unlock_lead: Each step is something you can do yourself.
pack.title: Application pack: {scheme}
pack.lead: Everything to get ready before you apply on the official channel.
pack.not_now: This scheme does not fit your business right now. The pack is for reference only.
pack.no_documents: No document list is available for this scheme yet.
pack.draft_note: A starting point in English, the language of most forms. Review and complete every [fill in] before use.
pack.download_failed: The PDF could not be made. Try again.
pack.never: You apply yourself. We never submit anything or log in for you.
pack.tracker: Where are you with this application?
pack.tracker_note: Tap the step you have reached.
watch.title: What changed
watch.lead: When something about your business changes, we check every scheme again and tell you what got better.
watch.edit: For any other change, update your answers:
watch.empty_help: Updates appear here when a change opens a scheme for you.
q.monthly_sales_inr: About how much do you sell in a month?
q.monthly_costs_inr: About how much does the business spend in a month? Count purchases, rent and wages.
q.existing_emis_inr: How much do you already pay each month on other loans?
why.monthly_sales_inr: Optional. We use it only to check whether a loan instalment fits your cash. It does not change eligibility.
why.monthly_costs_inr: Optional. Sales minus costs shows what is left each month to repay a loan.
why.existing_emis_inr: Optional. Instalments you already pay reduce what is left for a new loan. Tap ₹0 if none.
afford.title: Can you afford the repayment?
afford.lead: A rough check of the monthly instalment against your cash. It does not change whether you may be eligible.
afford.line: Estimated EMI {emi}/month at {rate}% for {months} months (assumed; your bank's rate may differ)
afford.no_fixed: No fixed EMI; interest depends on usage.
afford.missing_cash: Add monthly sales and costs to check affordability:
afford.needs_report: A new unit needs a project report to check this:
afford.ratio: Share of that taken by the EMI
afford.dscr: Year 1 DSCR from your project report
afford.note: The rate and tenure are our assumptions, not official figures. Up to 30% of what is left is comfortable, up to 40% is tight.
afford.pmegp_note: Conservative: ignores how the bank adjusts the subsidy.
pack.project_note: Banks ask for a project report for a new unit. Enter a few figures and we work out the cost, finance, 3-year projection and repayment table.
project.title: Project report
project.lead: A draft of the report a bank asks for when you start a new unit. You give the figures; every number in the report is calculated from them.
project.only_new: The project report is meant for a new unit. Your profile says this is an existing business.
project.f.raw_material_pct_of_sales: Raw material as a share of sales
project.f.business_description: Describe the business in your own words
project.h.machinery_inr: Cost of machines and tools you will buy.
project.h.building_or_civil_inr: Enter 0 if the place is rented.
project.h.working_capital_inr: Money for stock and running costs at the start.
project.h.monthly_sales_year1_inr: What you expect to sell in a month.
project.h.monthly_fixed_costs_inr: Rent, wages, power and similar costs.
project.h.raw_material_pct_of_sales: If material costs half of what you sell, enter 50.
project.h.business_description: What you make or sell, and for whom. Do not write Aadhaar, PAN or account numbers.
project.missing: Fill in these to calculate the report:
project.mismatch: These details add up to {details}, but your profile says the project costs {profile}. Which is right? The report below uses {details}.
project.or_fix: or correct the figures above and calculate again.
project.terms: Assumed loan terms: {rate}% a year for {months} months. Your bank sets the real terms.
project.subsidy_note: Shown separately. The bank adjusts it as per scheme rules; this report does not model that.
project.dscr_note: DSCR = (cash accrual + interest) / (principal + interest). Below 1.0 cannot cover repayments, 1.0 to 1.5 is thin, 1.5 or more is comfortable. These bands are our assumption; banks set their own minimum.
project.narrative_note: Written in English for the bank. Complete every [fill in] before use.
